Manage the requirement gathering and RFP creation to deliver network and security technologies that meet business needs. Resolve escalated L2 & L3 technical issues and coordinate with internal and external parties until closure. Monitor MPLS, IOE, and other data communication links and provide periodic reports. Manage ISP’s, vendors and SI’s. Act as the link between Aldar Properties and Aldar Education for all Network & Security matters. Maintain network standardization and network equipment specifications Manage network assets (i.e. network hardware and software, monitoring tools). Ensure network changes and supports are recorded in ITSM and following the corporate SLAs where applicable. Responsible for relevant Change Management processes related to Network and Security Maintain support contracts for network infrastructure devices. Generate various performance reports, analyze those reports and make a recommendation to improve the network performance. Evaluate new network hardware and network solutions. Work with vendor/system integrators and principal manufacturer for new solutions design. Ensure that all Network & Security technologies, policies and procedures across Aldar Education business streams are up to date, based on best practice and of the highest standards. Guide the preparation of tendering documents (RFP, BoQ’s, SoW’s) and perform the technical assessment. Coordinate security issues with IT Team and external security consultants. Conducts system security audits as per assigned schedule to detect weaknesses in the security system as per Aldar Education quality standards and procedures. Plan and guide VAPT activities across the group. Supervise the technical integration of new schools and expansion projects, providing guidance to engineers and ensuring all standards and requirements are met. Prepares routine & special reports to highlight IT security issues/concerns/criticalities. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Communication or Computer Engineering Network Certification: CCNA, preferably CCNP CCNA Security or equivalent MSCE Brand specific certifications are a plus, such as Aruba and Cisco Minimum Experience: 12+ Years of experience in IT networking including administration and project management of IT infrastructure. Job Specific Knowledge: Strong knowledge of Network Protocols, network components, network operating systems and Security Standards. Hands-on Knowledge of procedures used for installation, modification, maintenance and repair of IT network hardware appliance, virtual appliance, and software. Strong knowledge of below network technologies, TCP/IP and IP Subnetting Structure cabling / Passive Networking SDWAN Solutions & Design Primciples Switching – Juniper, Cisco Routing – Juniper, Cisco Wireless – Aruba, Cisco IP Telephony – Cisco IP Telephony NAC Solution - Aruba Perimeter and Core Firewall – Juniper SRX, Palo Alto, Fortigate. Central network management and monitoring tools – Juniper STRM, Panorama, VPN – Site-to-Site IPSec VPN, Client-based and Client-less SSL/IPSec VPN DMZ networking Web Application Firewall – On-premise and Cloud-based WAF Anti-Virus Administration, Management and Monitoring Tool – SolarWinds, PRTG Virtualization and DR Solution – VMWare vSphere and SRM SAN Storage – DellEMC, Pure Storage OS – Windows Server and Windows 10 Skills: Strong analytical skills Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Ability to learn fast and keep abreast of new technologies. Technical and non-technical communication skills Project Management and Vendor Management Skills What We Offer: Aldar Education is a family of world-class, child-centered, and innovative schools based in the UAE. Aldar Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About EIS Technologies EIS Technologies is a specialized service-oriented system integrator delivering ICT, cyber security, IoT/AI, ELV, and audio-visual solutions to enterprise customers across multiple industries. As a full-service IT company, EIS supports organizations with traditional IT, analytics, cybersecurity, and big data needs, helping them simplify complex processes and improve efficiency. EIS serves sectors including retail, eCommerce, healthcare, education, hospitality, public sector, oil & gas, and financial services. Job Description  EIS Technologies is looking for a hands-on Network Engineer to design, deploy, troubleshoot, and support enterprise wired and wireless networks for our customers. You will work across a multi-vendor environment, take ownership of network implementation and migration activities, provide Tier-3 technical escalation support, and ensure successful delivery from design through post-implementation support. Key Tech Stack Aruba: Wired & Wireless, Controllers, Aruba Central, ClearPass. Extreme Networks: Switching, Fabric, NAC / ExtremeControl. Huawei: Enterprise routers, switches, and WLAN solutions. RUCKUS: Access Points, ICX switches, SmartZone / ZoneDirector. Fortinet FortiGate: Firewall administration, policy management, NAT, VPNs, and High Availability — mandatory. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, configure, and migrate enterprise LAN, WAN, and WLAN solutions. Install and configure switches, routers, wireless access points, controllers, and firewalls. Perform wireless site surveys and develop coverage plans and low-level designs. Troubleshoot complex routing, switching, wireless, and network security issues. Configure and manage VLANs, STP, LACP, routing protocols, QoS, and network segmentation. Configure and maintain FortiGate firewall policies, NAT rules, IPSec VPN tunnels, and HA environments. Support network authentication, access control, and NAC solutions. Analyse network performance and identify capacity, availability, and security improvements. Participate in network migrations, upgrades, cutovers, and technology refresh projects. Provide Tier-3 escalation support for complex incidents and technical issues. Prepare network diagrams, implementation plans, method statements, configuration documents, and technical reports. Prepare BOQs / BOMs and provide technical input for customer proposals. Coordinate with presales, project teams, vendors, distributors, and customer IT teams. Conduct testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities. Provide customer handover, knowledge transfer, and technical training where required. Provide post-implementation support and ensure technical issues are resolved within agreed timelines. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of networking, wireless, cybersecurity, and vendor technologies. Qualification Criteria 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking, preferably within a System Integrator environment. Strong practical experience in routing, switching, enterprise Wi-Fi, and network security. Hands-on experience with multiple enterprise networking vendors. Strong experience with FortiGate firewalls is mandatory . Good understanding of VLANs, STP, LACP, OSPF, BGP, QoS, NAT, VPNs, and network segmentation. Experience deploying and troubleshooting enterprise wireless networks. Experience with network controllers, cloud management platforms, and network monitoring tools. Experience performing wireless site surveys and preparing technical designs. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to read network diagrams, project specifications, BOQs, and technical documentation. Strong customer-facing communication and technical presentation skills. Ability to independently manage onsite implementation and troubleshooting activities. Experience working on enterprise projects involving migrations, upgrades, and multi-vendor environments. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and technical priorities. UAE / GCC System Integrator experience is preferred. UAE driving licence is preferred. Preferred Certifications Relevant certifications in the following technologies will be an advantage: Aruba / HPE Networking Extreme Networks Huawei Enterprise Networking RUCKUS Networks Fortinet

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: Senior Network Engineer – Shape the Network Services Behind the Nordics Would you like your engineering work to reach far beyond a single platform or customer? At GlobalConnect, you’ll help shape network services on infrastructure that carries more than half of Scandinavia’s internet connections — connecting businesses, hospitals and public services. This is an opportunity to combine practical engineering with service design and turn complex network needs into reliable solutions that work on a Nordic scale. Build services that people and businesses rely on every day As our Senior Network Engineer – Underlay & Service Development , you’ll work at the intersection of network engineering, technology and product. Your focus will be to turn service concepts into repeatable, scalable network offerings across our Nordic infrastructure. Your day could start with discussing what a new service needs to offer customers. From there, you might translate those needs into an underlay architecture, define service models and configuration templates, or validate a new setup in the lab. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch. You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. You’ll also contribute throughout the service lifecycle — from technical design and validation to launch, documentation and ongoing improvements. In short, you’ll help turn good network engineering into services that customers can depend on. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and evolving underlay architecture for new and existing network services. Translating service requirements into scalable architectures, service models, configuration templates and APIs. Building automation and OSS integrations using technologies such as Python, Ansible, YANG/NETCONF, gNMI and REST. Running lab validation and pilots, followed by post-launch tuning and service lifecycle work. Working across Product, OSS/BSS, NOC, Security and suppliers to establish service KPIs, acceptance criteria and smooth operational handovers. Join the team behind the Nordics’ digital infrastructure You’ll join a Nordic group of experienced network engineers working with Internet, IP-VPN, L2 and DDoS mitigation services. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of the job, and you’ll have plenty of opportunities to exchange ideas with colleagues in engineering, product and operations. Why GlobalConnect? Our fiber and network infrastructure forms part of the digital foundation of Scandinavia, carrying connections used by organizations ranging from smaller businesses to hospitals, enterprises and public services. That scale creates interesting engineering problems — and room to explore new technologies, improve how services are built and automated, and broaden your knowledge across the Nordics. To Thrive Here, We Think You Need 5+ years of experience in carrier or large-enterprise networking, including practical underlay work supporting telecom services. Deep technical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, MPLS L3VPN/L2VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing and OSPF/IS-IS, plus experience with multi-tenant services, wholesale interconnects or peering. Practical experience connecting networks with OSS/BSS, orchestration platforms or service controllers using technologies such as REST APIs and YANG/NETCONF. Experience with vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Arista is relevant. Fluent in English, fluency in a Scandinavian language is a plus. Based in either Copenhagen, Stockholm, Uppsala, or Oslo, where we have our offices. Ready to help shape what runs underneath the connected Nordics? If you’re motivated by solving substantial technical problems, sharing knowledge and seeing your engineering become reliable services used across society, this could be your next step. At GlobalConnect, you’ll have room to deepen your technical skills while contributing to network infrastructure that matters every day. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. We don’t need a personal letter unless there’s something that requires a special explanation and isn’t covered in your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you. About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Ensure the safe, efficient, and sustainable delivery of production and operational targets. Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the Company's Life Of Asset. Drive operational discipline, productivity, equipment utilization, and continuous improvement. Ensure effective integration between mining, technical, processing, maintenance, and support functions. Safety, Risk & Compliance Provide visible leadership in promoting a strong safety culture across all operations. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Company standards, policies, and industry best practices. Identify and manage operational risks that may affect safety, production, cost, or business continuity. Promote a culture of accountability and proactive risk management. Production & Operational Performance Deliver agreed production, development, productivity, recovery, and cost targets. Monitor operational performance through appropriate KPIs and management systems. Identify operational constraints and implement corrective actions to improve performance. Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives across the business. Strategic Planning Contribute to the development and implementation of the Company's operational and strategic plans Provide operational input into life-of-mine planning, budgets, capital projects, and production forecasts. Ensure alignment between short-, medium-, and long-term operational plans. Support the evaluation and implementation of major mining projects and operational expansions. People & Leadership Lead and develop a high-performing mining leadership team. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, performance, and continuous improvement. Develop succession plans and technical leadership capability within the organisation. Promote local talent development and effective workforce planning.. Financial & Commercial Management Ensure operations are managed within approved budgets and cost parameters. Drive cost optimisation and productivity improvement without compromising safety or operational integrity. Provide input into capital expenditure decisions and major operational investments. Ensure effective utilisation of mining resources, equipment, and infrastructure. Stakeholder Management Work closely with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board, and other senior stakeholders to deliver business objectives. Maintain effective relationships with internal departments, contractors, government authorities, and other relevant stakeholders. Strong understanding of mining cost management, budgeting, forecasting, and capital expenditure management. Ability to interpret and use operational data, KPIs, production metrics, and performance dashboards to drive decision-making. Knowledge of mining technology, automation, digitalisation, and modern mining systems. Strong understanding of mining legislation, regulatory requirements, environmental standards, and industry best practices. review_candidates.description: On behalf of our client, a Telecommunications client servicing the law enforcement sector internationally based in Nicosia, GRS Recruitment is seeking a Senior Project Manager. As Senior Project Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of complex, multi-disciplinary projects — from requirement definition and planning through execution, delivery, and successful handover in the customer's environment. You will operate at the center of a matrix organization, aligning R&D, Product, QA, Operations, and customers around a single plan, and you'll set the standard for how project management is done. This is a senior, high-ownership position for someone who combines strong technical fluency with the leadership to drive decisions, manage risk, and deliver on time and on budget. MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end delivery of multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle — scoping, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing — for both internal product development and customer-facing turnkey programs. Define project scope, objectives, and technical feasibility together with all relevant internal departments, and translate them into a realistic, resource-loaded work plan. Lead execution across a strong matrix organization — R&D (HW & SW), Product Management, QA, Integration, Operations, and Logistics — keeping every stakeholder aligned on requirements, schedule, and budget. Drive HW and SW R&D through every phase: scoping, planning, task and milestone tracking, testing, and handover to production. Take full responsibility for delivering on time, to quality and technical specification, and within the agreed budget. Own delivery risk end to end — identify, communicate, and drive mitigation and contingency plans before issues become delays; escalate decisively when needed. Establish and run clear communication plans; report progress, metrics (quality, performance, capacity/load), and risks to management and customers. Lead the creation of project documentation — SOW, technical characterization, user manuals, training materials — and manage CRM data throughout the project. Direct and guide cross-functional teams throughout the process, facilitating debate and driving timely decisions on the right solutions. Secure customer acceptance of deliverables, and run post-project evaluations to capture what worked and what to improve. Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, key partners, and customers. Mentor and elevate project management practice across the organization, leading the rollout of new processes and tools. CANDIDATE PROFILE B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering field. 5+ years managing complex, multi-disciplinary projects end to end, including R&D (HW and/or SW) deliveries. Proven experience delivering large-scale development projects on schedule and within budget. Deep working knowledge of RF is a plus. Demonstrated success operating in a matrix environment and leading cross-departmental processes. review_candidates.description: About Evidence Action At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations. Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions. Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains. Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children. Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives. At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions. The Role You will oversee Evidence Action's new In-Line Chlorination Innovation Team, under the Safe Water Now Program. Evidence Action's Safe Water Now program provides access to safe drinking water across Kenya, Uganda, Malawi, and India through water chlorination. Backed by rigorous research showing chlorination can reduce child mortality by more than 20%, safe water is one of the most cost-effective health interventions globally. The program's newest intervention, In-Line Chlorination (ILC), automatically treats water as it flows through piped systems, requiring less behavior change from end users than existing solutions. As ILC scales up, core questions remain about how to optimize device performance, reduce operational costs, and strengthen community engagement. Answering these questions well will shape whether ILC can become a scalable, cost-effective model reaching millions more people. Evidence Action is investing in a dedicated Innovation team to find those answers. You will lead that effort. Based in Mbale, Uganda, you will hire and build a dedicated team and run rapid field pilots to test the most promising improvements to the ILC model. Where pilots succeed, you will ensure those innovations are scaled across the portfolio and into future geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Evidence Action's Uganda country team, the Regional team in Kenya, and the Global team in the United States, with visibility and input from program leadership at every level. Direct Reports Senior Associate, Innovation and Learning Senior Associate, Innovation and Data Insights Responsibilities Managing Rapid Field Activities: Design and execute short, focused field pilots that produce clear recommendations on whether innovations should be scaled into the broader ILC program Define pilot scope, success criteria, and decision points; continuously monitor progress and iterate on both pilot design and the intervention being tested Ensure data reliability throughout, including robust measurement protocols and routine sense checks on field data Recommend accelerating, modifying, or terminating tests based on early signal rather than running every pilot to completion Technical Ownership of ILC : Serve as a technical owner of ILC device performance and design, working closely with Evidence Action engineering teams across the region Develop deep familiarity with device types, infrastructure configurations, and modifications deployed across countries to to help prioritize pilots and identify novel innovations to test Engage with external technical experts and partners as needed to support device design and testing approaches Prioritization and Planning : Contribute to prioritizing which innovations to test and in what sequence, working closely with the Global and Regional program teams Translate high-level priorities into concrete testing plans with defined timelines, resource requirements, and decision points Documentation and Knowledge Capture : Ensure pilot results, operational learnings, and technical decisions are systematically documented to inform the ILC operational handbook and new geography playbook Coordination with Country, Regional, and Global Teams : Manage the interface between the Innovation team and the Uganda country team, including clear communication on scope, timeline, and device management changes Ensure innovation work does not disrupt ongoing program operations and deliver outputs the program team can act on Coordinate regularly with Regional and Global teams on progress, findings, and strategic direction Key Performance Indicators Number of Completed Pilots: You will be assessed on how many pilots are completed each year, targeting :2-3 months per pilot, iterating continuously on design throughout each pilot Number of Decisions made from Pilots: You will be assessed on how much each pilot aids overall decision-making, ensuring each recommendation is evidence-backed, has robust data, and answers the core question with enough detail to adopt, improve, or stop the new approach Adoption of Improvements: You will be assessed on how many of the proven ideas ultimately are deployed across the program, such as in operational manuals or in future trainings Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Water Sciences, Environmental or Applied Sciences, Economics, or a related field. Candidates with a Master's degree in Water Systems, WASH, Hydrology, or a technical research discipline are strongly preferred, though exceptional field practitioners with a Bachelor's degree are warmly encouraged to apply 5+ years of demonstrable experience in technical field operations and applied research program management Experience designing and executing field pilots or structured experiments that resulted in operational changes at scale, not just reports Background in WASH, water quality, or a closely related technical field; engineering training strongly preferred Experience building and managing small, multidisciplinary teams, particularly those including technical field staff Data fluency: able to design testing protocols, identify measurement issues, and distinguish meaningful results from noise. Statistical expertise not required but must be a critical consumer of data Demonstrated ability to work across complex organizational structures with multiple stakeholders and no single clean reporting line Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration; able to scope and launch activities quickly under time pressure Strong documentation and communication skills; able to translate field findings into clear recommendations for diverse audiences Position Location This role will be based in Mbale, Uganda , with regular travel to field sites. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of Uganda employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Uganda for roles based in Uganda. Note: Applications will be reviewed on rolling basis. Benefits Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide*. Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance (medical cover for self and dependents) Pension/Retirement savings options Paid leave Avenues for engagement and recognition

Department Overview Silvus is seeking a Customer Operations Manager who will report to the International Customer Operations Lead. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post-sales operational liaison between our key customers and Silvus manufacturing organization and internal associated departments. The mission is to manage purchase orders, production schedules, delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s long-term production roadmap. This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location. The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to report on delivery performance, quality metrics, and roadmap alignment. Demand Planning & Forecast Integration: Work directly with customer demand planners to ingest production forecasts. Translate these into actionable data for our internal manufacturing and supply chain teams to prevent stockouts or overages. Delivery Management: Track and manage open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery commitments are met, partnering with manufacturing and logistics to resolve delays. Technical Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Identify technical hurdles or integration challenges the customer is facing. Partner with Engineering to resolve issues and manage the formal escalation process for any hardware defects or shipping delays. Lifecycle Management: Monitor component performance in the field. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" internally, providing feedback to Product Development to influence the design of future components or products. RMA Management: Managing the Return Merchandise Authorization process - making sure that if a part fails, the customer gets a replacement immediately and your engineering team gets the "dead" part back for analysis. Regional Expertise: Navigate the specific logistical, legal, and contractual complexities unique to key countries like Germany and the Ukrainian theater. Perform other related duties of which the above are representative. Basic Requirements A self-motivated professional who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities. Experience: 5+ years in a post-sales, account management, or technical project management role, preferably within the Defense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries. Analytical Prowess: Ability to analyze complex spreadsheets and production schedules to find discrepancies between demand and supply. Communication: Demonstrated ability to "translate" between a customer's high-level business needs and a factory's granular production constraints. Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. Experience managing military or defense-sector clients is considered a significant asset. Clearance: All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check. Travel Requirements 10-25% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan No EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch. You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. new_matches.title: Senior Microsoft 365 Architect (Czech required)
new_matches.description: Senior Microsoft 365 Architect Koho hledáme? Do našeho týmu Digital Workplace hledáme zkušeného kolegu – parťáka, který se stane technickou autoritou pro oblast infrastruktury Microsoft 365. Hledáme „tahouna“, který dokáže projekty nejen odpracovat, ale i vymyslet a obhájit. Potřebujeme člověka, který ovládá delivery projektů od A do Z. To znamená, že dokážete udělat vstupní analýzu, navrhnout architekturu řešení, naplánovat postup a následně provést samotnou migraci či implementaci. Budete se soustředit na komplexní prostředí, hybridní scénáře a bezpečnost. Co Vás čeká? End-to-End Delivery projektů: Kompletní zastřešení technických projektů – od úvodní analýzy stavu přes návrh cílového řešení až po samotnou realizaci a migraci (např. fúze společností, Tenant-to-Tenant migrace, divestice). Správa a rozvoj hybridního prostředí: Péče o komplexní identity management. Zaměření na Active Directory (On-prem), Entra ID (Azure AD), AD Connect a řešení hybridních scénářů pro Exchange. Architektura a Hardening M365: Zvyšování bezpečnosti tenantů (Security Hardening). Nastavování a zpřísňování politik, řešení identit, Tiering modelů a zabezpečení přístupů. Exchange Online a Messaging: Migrace poštovních služeb (Exchange On-prem to Online, 3rd party to Exchange Online), řešení mail flow, hybridní konfigurace a troubleshooting. Konzultace a technický design: Spolupráce s byznysem a ostatními IT týmy. Budete tím, kdo navrhne, „jak to udělat“, aby řešení bylo robustní, bezpečné a dlouhodobě udržitelné. Automatizace správy: Využití PowerShellu a Graph API pro efektivní správu identit, hromadné změny a automatizaci procesů. Co od Váš očekáváme? Expertní znalost Microsoft ekosystému: Hloubková orientace v Microsoft 365, Exchange (On-prem/Online) a Active Directory. Rozumíte tomu, jak fungují identity v hybridním prostředí. Zkušenost s migračními projekty: Máte za sebou prokazatelné zkušenosti s migracemi (např. T2T, On-prem to Cloud) a znáte úskalí těchto procesů. Umíte používat migrační nástroje (např. BitTitan, Quest nebo nativní MS nástroje). Analytické a architektonické myšlení: Schopnost převzít zadání, provést analýzu současného stavu a samostatně navrhnout migrační strategii a cílovou architekturu. Pokročilou znalost PowerShellu: Skriptování je pro vás denní chleba – ať už jde o reporting, správu Exchange nebo manipulaci s objekty v AD/Entra ID. Znalost Security principů: Orientace v oblasti M365 Security & Compliance (Conditional Access, Identity Protection aj.). Samostatnost a dotahování věcí: Hledáme někoho, kdo si projekt vezme za svůj a doručí ho do úspěšného konce bez nutnosti mikromanagementu. Konzultantské dovednosti: Schopnost vysvětlit složité technické koncepty, obhájit si navržené řešení a komunikovat v angličtině (min. B1/B2) pro spolupráci v mezinárodním prostředí. Co vám nabízíme? Jedinečnou příležitost uplatnění v silné, stabilní a neustále rostoucí skupině CSG. Motivační finanční ohodnocení, balíček benefitů. Možnost osobního a karierního růstu.

This role will provide overall leadership across both Underground and Open-Pit mining operations, integrating mining, technical, engineering, maintenance, processing, and operational support functions to achieve business objectives. The incumbent will have, among others, the following responsibilities, which are not exhaustive: Operational Leadership Provide overall leadership and direction to mining operations across underground and open-pit environments. Ensure the safe, efficient, and sustainable delivery of production and operational targets. Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the Company's Life Of Asset. Drive operational discipline, productivity, equipment utilization, and continuous improvement. Ensure effective integration between mining, technical, processing, maintenance, and support functions. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Company standards, policies, and industry best practices. Identify and manage operational risks that may affect safety, production, cost, or business continuity. Promote a culture of accountability and proactive risk management. Production & Operational Performance Deliver agreed production, development, productivity, recovery, and cost targets. Monitor operational performance through appropriate KPIs and management systems. Identify operational constraints and implement corrective actions to improve performance. Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives across the business. Strategic Planning Contribute to the development and implementation of the Company's operational and strategic plans Provide operational input into life-of-mine planning, budgets, capital projects, and production forecasts. Ensure alignment between short-, medium-, and long-term operational plans. Support the evaluation and implementation of major mining projects and operational expansions. People & Leadership Lead and develop a high-performing mining leadership team. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, performance, and continuous improvement. Develop succession plans and technical leadership capability within the organisation. Promote local talent development and effective workforce planning.. Financial & Commercial Management Ensure operations are managed within approved budgets and cost parameters. Drive cost optimisation and productivity improvement without compromising safety or operational integrity. Provide input into capital expenditure decisions and major operational investments. Ensure effective utilisation of mining resources, equipment, and infrastructure. Stakeholder Management Work closely with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board, and other senior stakeholders to deliver business objectives. Maintain effective relationships with internal departments, contractors, government authorities, and other relevant stakeholders. Represent the Company's operational interests at senior management and external forums when required. Job Requirements Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering or a related mining/engineering discipline. Postgraduate qualifications in Mining Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or a related field would be advantageous. Extensive senior operational experience in the mining industry, preferably within large-scale copper or similar mining operations. Significant experience across both underground and open-pit mining environments. Proven experience in a senior leadership position with responsibility for large-scale mining operations. Excellent command of English is required. Strong understanding of mine planning, production, development, mining methods, equipment, operational optimisation, and cost management. Demonstrated experience managing large multidisciplinary teams and complex mining operations. Strong track record of delivering safety, production, productivity, and financial performance targets. Knowledge & Competencies Extensive knowledge of underground and open-pit mining operations, including mining methods, production, development, and operational planning. Strong understanding of mine planning, scheduling, production optimisation, and Life-of-Mine (LOM) planning. Sound knowledge of mining equipment, fleet management, maintenance strategies, and equipment utilisation. Strong understanding of geotechnical, ventilation, dewatering, ground control, and mine infrastructure requirements. Knowledge of mineral processing and the integration between mining and processing operations. Strong knowledge of mine safety, risk management, critical controls, and operational compliance. Demonstrated ability to apply operational excellence, continuous improvement, and productivity improvement methodologies. Strong understanding of mining cost management, budgeting, forecasting, and capital expenditure management. Ability to interpret and use operational data, KPIs, production metrics, and performance dashboards to drive decision-making. Knowledge of mining technology, automation, digitalisation, and modern mining systems. Strong understanding of mining legislation, regulatory requirements, environmental standards, and industry best practices. Ability to integrate technical, operational, commercial, and people considerations when making strategic decisions. Demonstrated ability to manage and optimise large-scale, complex mining operations across multiple disciplines. KCC SA does not accept applications submitted by people under the age of eighteen (18). However, as part of its Equal Opportunity, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion program, applications from women are strongly encouraged. In accordance with our Compliance Policy and Code of Conduct, KCC SA or its employees do not receive any remuneration or benefits of any kind at any stage of the recruitment process. Myndigheten leds av en generaldirektör och har cirka 90 anställda. Myndigheten har kontor i Karlstad och Solna. GD-staben är generaldirektörens stöd för strategisk samordning, utveckling, förvaltning och ledning av myndigheten. I avdelningens ansvar ingår bland annat ledning och samordning av myndighetens internationella verksamhet. Nu inrättar vi en enhet för internationella frågor med placering vid GD-staben. Organiseringen av myndighetens internationella frågor har setts över i syfte att utveckla och förstärka det internationella arbetet och ge förbättrade förutsättningar för ett strategiskt arbete i genomförandet av myndighetens uppdrag. Rollen som enhetschef är därmed ny och det finns stora möjligheter att vara med och utforma den. Arbetsuppgifter Som chef för Enheten för internationella frågor ansvarar du för verksamhet, personal och budget. Du rapporterar till stabschefen. Du kommer leda en grupp av kvalificerade medarbetare i arbetet med att samordna MPF:s internationella verksamhet inklusive sekonderingar samt myndighetens uppdrag kopplat till Ukraina. I rollen ligger att säkerställa den löpande verksamheten såväl som att driva frågor på en strategisk nivå. Det innebär bland annat att du förväntas kunna relatera processer och frågor till aktuell policyutveckling i Sverige och internationellt och till bredden i myndighetens uppdrag. I din roll ingår samverkan externt gentemot andra myndigheter och organisationer nationellt och internationellt. Du ska också främja samarbete internt med övriga avdelningar på MPF. Konkret innebär detta att säkerställa att enheten bidrar med relevant kunskap och samordning. Resor i tjänsten internationellt förekommer. Kvalifikationer Detta arbete kräver: Akademisk examen som arbetsgivaren finner relevant. Aktuell chefserfarenhet eller ledarerfarenhet inom för MPF relevanta områden. Erfarenhet från arbete i Regeringskansliet eller statlig myndighet, EU:s institutioner, eller Nato. Erfarenhet av att driva utvecklingsarbeten och leda i förändring. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Det är meriterande om du har: God kunskap om totalförsvar och säkerhetspolitik. Erfarenhet från andra internationella organisationer med bäring på MPF:s verksamhet. Personliga egenskaper: Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och söker dig som har god förmåga att leda, utveckla och motivera andra. Du bygger och upprätthåller goda relationer och nätverk internt och externt. Du kan prioritera, har en hög integritet och en tydlig säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga, ett gott omdöme och en tydlig utgångspunkt i den statliga värdegrunden. Som enhetschef ska du kunna företräda myndigheten i nationella som internationella sammanhang där hög professionalitet och omdöme är en förutsättning. Om anställningen Anställningen är tillsvidare på heltid och inleds med provanställning. Vi gör en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt bestämmelserna i säkerhetsskyddslagen. new_matches.description: About SINGU At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business. Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started. Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation. About The Role This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature. The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case , not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance. SINGU supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition. Why Strong Sellers Join SINGU A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch. Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential. Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship. Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee. Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance. Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership. What You Will Own Pipeline and Coverage A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it. Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory. Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk. Deal Execution Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer. Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor. Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount. Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision. Land and Expand First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start. A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented. Forecasting and Governance A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind. Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed. Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases. What Excellent Performance Looks Like Commercial outcomes New-logo ARR against quota Pipeline creation and territory coverage Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision Average deal value and total multi-year value Strategic logos won Operating standards Forecast accuracy and stage integrity Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality Price protection and discount discipline CRM quality and process discipline Your First 12 Months First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities. By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced. By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential. What We’re Looking For Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years. Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics. The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost. English and Arabic language at business level. A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice. Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business. CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage. Package, Support and Progression Base salary up to AED 365,000 (approx. £75,000) based on your experience, with uncapped commission on top. Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota. Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers. This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you. If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Experience in a dual-hat role (industry leadership + external advisory) or within a captive consulting unit of a financial institution. new_matches.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you'll spend your time writing code. You'll work with partner technical teams and end users to understand what they actually need, then design and build the solution yourself: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment. You'll be close enough to the mission to see why the problem matters, and you'll ship fast, because what you build gets used in the field almost immediately. Once a solution proves itself, you'll work with our core platform team to fold the durable parts back into the product, so your work keeps paying off beyond the deployment you built it for. Responsibilities Design and build software applications that solve specific operational problems for our partners, owning them end-to-end from architecture through deployment. Take loosely defined, real-world requirements from partner militaries and organizations and turn them into working software, often on tight timelines. Build interfaces and connectors between our platforms and partner systems, and validate data flows end-to-end in the field. Deploy your solutions on site, gather feedback directly from operators, and iterate quickly based on what you see working (or not) in practice. Spot patterns and capabilities worth building into the core product, and work with our platform engineering team to get them there. Debug issues in live operational settings, drive them to resolution, and document what you learn along the way. Build real working relationships with client technical teams and end users so you understand their problems well enough to solve them properly. Requirements 4+ years building and shipping production software, in Python and at least one lower-level language (C++, Rust, Go). A track record of defining and building end-to-end systems: projects, internships, or early-career work where you took an ambiguous problem to a working, deployed solution. Comfortable owning software end-to-end — design, build, debug, deploy — including on Linux, in operational or field conditions. Confident and clear communicating with client technical teams and senior stakeholders, with a bias to action Practical under constraint: ill-defined problems, tight deadlines, and a working solution over a theoretically perfect one. Travel: frequent on site with partners, domestic and international. Proficiency in English is mandatory. Nice to have Prior forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering experience. Depth in computer vision, deep learning, mission planning, robotics, or embedded software. Degree from a leading engineering school. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
